findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: audit_url, tab_history, get_audit, get_patch, contact · Private data: audit_url, create_guest, watch_tab, get_patch, contact · Public sink: run_tab, embed_snippet, contact · Destructive: run_tab, tab_history, lab_test.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: audit_url, tab_history, get_audit, get_patch, contact · Private data: audit_url, create_guest, watch_tab, get_patch, contact · Public sink: run_tab, embed_snippet, contact · Destructive: run_tab, tab_history, lab_test

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
